description.en: Class 9 social science: democracy and elections, early humans, the state and society, climate, landforms and oceans, and economics: choices, prices, personal finance and startups. Maps, timelines and short questions. Works offline.

blurb.en: Eleven Class 9 modules on history, democracy, elections, geography and economics.

highlights.en: Maps, timelines and diagrams you can move and explore
Real places and events from India
Short questions after each idea, with a hint when you need one
Works offline once a lesson is opened
